analysis_unit: one unique NCT ID plus raw outcome title

asset.format: UTF-8 CSV compressed with deterministic gzip

paper_denominator_reconciliation.explanation: The paper count refers to row-level AACT outcome records. The recovered mapping lacks an AACT outcome-row identifier, so the public extract uses the reproducible NCT ID plus raw title key and must not replace the paper denominator.

transformation: Removed condition and terminology columns; deduplicated the condition-expanded source by NCT ID and raw outcome title; selected modal field values with alphabetical tie-breaks; retained per-field variant counts.
